defects.description: a tiny round pitch-dark hollow pit about one-fortieth to one-tenth as wide as the shell with a rough torn light-tan crumbly rim and matte black interior
a thin jagged dark-brown hairline fracture about half as long as the shell width with rough uneven split edges exposing pale creamy kernel beneath
defects.severity_note: any fracture, from thin hairline split to broken-away piece exposing kernel

defects.description: a straight-edged pale beige slit about one-tenth to two-fifths as long as the shell width with smooth clean sides revealing lighter fibrous inner material
defects.severity_note: any knife cut, slice or notch; usually 2-8 mm long

defects.description: a small flat dark-blue ink stamp lettering patch about one-fifth as wide as the shell with smooth matte printed texture contrasting the natural brown shell
